title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. •         Developing a context-sensitive methodology for assessing and monitoring soil health at contaminated sites using geophysical characterisation methods
•         Integrating soil health descriptors, ecosystem services, and EU regulatory frameworks (including the Soil Monitoring Law) into a unified assessment approach applicable across urban and peri-urban settings
•         Evaluating site-specific phytomanagement strategies through multi-criteria analysis connecting biophysical and economic descriptors
•       Building and enhancing the existing NBenefit$ tool of LIST by combining system dynamic modelling of ecological processes, life cycle assessment (LCA), and life cycle costing (LCC) into an evidence-based simulation framework
•         Applying the enhanced NBenefit$ tool to a real case study in Wallonia in collaboration with industry partner Siterem
•         Collaborating with Doctoral Candidate of Linköping University (DC14) on joint synthesis work contributing to the overall objectives of WP4
•         Engaging in four secondments for a total of 12 months at University of Gent (3 moths); Linköping University (4 months); University of Milano-Bicocca (4 months); Siterem-Belgium (1 month):

•           Academic background covering topics such as soil science, soil remediation technologies, life cycle assessment, ecosystem services, soil ecology, phytoremediation and bioremediation, geophysics
•           Up to 2 years of experience (including research, academic work or courses) in soil assessment, contaminated land management, or related fields

•         Experience with or strong interest in system dynamic modelling

•         Proficiency in data analysis, scientific writing, and relevant modelling or programming tools

•         Strong integrative thinking, able to connect biophysical, economic, and regulatory dimensions
•         Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and international research environment
•         Proactive and autonomous, with strong organisational skills

Language skills

•              Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages (French, German, Luxembourgish) are an asset.

description:
Head of MI & Reporting
Finance - Group - UI0801 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

About Waystone

Summary:

The Head of MI & Reporting is the engine room of Group FP&A's management information function. The role owns the monthly MI cycle end-to-end  from data aggregation and system integrity through to investor-grade reporting and executive presentations- and leads two direct reports in delivering that cycle with rigour and consistency. Critically, this role is the integrating layer between the FP&A business partners and the broader finance function. Success depends on aligning inputs across the team, driving standardisation in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, and ensuring that reporting outputs are consistently high-quality, actionable and suited to an executive audience.
          
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MI & Investor Reporting

• Own the monthly Group MI pack end-to-end: production, commentary, quality control and delivery to FP&A leadership, Waystone Executive team and investors, on time and to a consistently high standard.
• Lead all standard investor reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis; manage ad-hoc queries from investors promptly and accurately.
• Own the Group reporting calendar, ensuring all key reporting requirements are known, tracked and executed by the FP&A team.
• Produce flash revenue reporting across legal entities, countries and product structures, with KPI and trend analysis that gives management a clear and timely read on performance.

FP&A Systems, Data & analytics

• Own the FP&A systems and toolset, ensuring data is well-controlled, models are scalable, and that new data sources are integrated in a structured and controlled way.
• Ensuring that the structuring of our data leads to improvements in our data quality/governance, and also surfaces relevant data in a more impactful way
• Comfortable with driving finance systems & finance process efficiency. You will identify and drive positive change to system structures and related processes which will support FP&A in raising our level.
• Experienced in driving automation in financial processes, and curious about the deployment of AI tooling to support efficiencies or deeper insights.
• Drive standardisation across the team in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, reducing reliance on fragmented individual processes and moving to consistent, repeatable approaches.
• Coordinate the wider FP&A team to engage with Financial Control with the goal of addressing potential General Ledger integrity issues or identifying improvements to ERP data entry to enhance reporting.
• Work with relevant departments to gather client revenue and cost of sales data for analytical purposes, building reliable data flows that FP&A can depend on.

Revenue Analysis & Forward-Looking Insight

• Deliver monthly analysis on Opportunities, Wins and Onboarding to provide forward-looking insight into revenue trends and the pipeline impact on future performance.
• Connect revenue run-rate and ARR outputs (built by the wider FP&A team) into the MI reporting suite so that executives have a consistent view of both current and forward performance.
• Identify performance trends, anomalies and risks in the data and surface these with clear, well-evidenced commentary in the MI materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Partner across FP&A and broader Finance function to co-ordinate the annual budget process for revenue and cost of sales, ensuring alignment of inputs and consistent methodology.
• Co-ordinate the quarterly revenue and cost of sales forecasting process with the country business partners.
• Prepare high-quality presentation materials to support budgeting and forecasting conversations with senior stakeholders.

Business Partnering & Coordination

• Act as the integrating layer between FP&A business partners and the MI function - aligning inputs, resolving data conflicts, ensuring all FP&A output is consistent across the various reporting layers and ensuring that what goes into the monthly pack reflects a single, agreed version of the truth.
• Collaborate with Country and Product leadership to provide financial guidance and ensure MI outputs are relevant, actionable and understood by the business.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with all key internal and external stakeholders, including investors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two, setting clear priorities, defining reporting outputs and creating an environment where the team can do their best work.
• Continuously evolve how the team measures and presents performance, always seeking to increase the actionable impact of the analysis.
• Raise the bar on presentation quality across the team, ensuring all outputs - whether for internal leadership or external investors — are executive-ready.

REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience:

• 10+ years post-qualified finance experience, with a meaningful proportion in FP&A or financial reporting in a complex, multi-entity environment.
• Proven track record of producing high-quality MI and management reporting for a senior or executive audience.
• Experience owning or managing financial planning and reporting systems, with a strong understanding of data flows and model architecture.
• Demonstrable ability to work with large, complex data sets- extracting insight, identifying anomalies and communicating findings clearly.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant messaging for non-finance audiences.
• Experience managing and developing direct reports.
• Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.

Desirable

• Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or similar BI and automation tooling; a track record of improving reporting efficiency through technology.
• Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Adaptive Planning or Salesforce.
• Experience in financial services, asset management or a similarly data-intensive, multi-jurisdiction business.

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent) preferred

description:

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

As Business Resilience Officer, you will be part of the Clearstream Securities Services (CSS) Business Resilience function within the Independent Business Risk and Control (IBRC) area, supporting the governance of first line of defence (1LoD) risk and control practices, with a focus on strengthening the effectiveness, quality and efficiency of the internal control environment.

In this role, you will support the team in connecting processes, risks, controls, findings, incidents, claims and remediation activities into a single risk-resilience cycle. You will contribute to a robust, proportionate and fit-for-purpose Internal Control System (ICS), while building your analytical skills and progressively adopting data, automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities under the guidance of more experienced colleagues.

Your responsibilities:

• Support ICS quality and efficiency: Perform analysis on the quality, adequacy, completeness and consistency of CSS processes, risks and controls, and support continuous improvements towards proportionate, balanced and efficient ICS key controls.
• Support audit and supervisory remediation: Assist in the coordination of regulatory onsite inspections and in the tracking of significant internal, statutory and regulatory findings, including support to evidence collection, Corrective Action Plan (CAP) documentation and remediation progress monitoring.
• Assist external assurance coordination: Support ISAE 3402 and SOC 2 audit work, including preparation of documentation, drafting of observations, follow-up on improvement measures and liaison with the external auditor under the supervision of more senior team members.
• Contribute to integrated control reporting: Support connecting-the-dots analysis and reporting across internal and external findings, Self-Identified Issues (SII), claims and goodwill, and incidents, helping to provide a comprehensive view of control maturity, failure events and actionable remediation; contribute to the Annual Management Report on Internal Controls.
• Support SII and CAP lifecycle management: Assist in the identification of SIIs and associated CAPs, help maintain the inventory, monitor remediation progress and support transparent reporting.
• Contribute to the risk-resilience cycle: Support the integration, rationalisation and elevation of the risk-resilience cycle by helping to challenge business practices and supporting the simplification and automation of processes, including the adoption of AI tools and techniques.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Banking, Finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in the financial services industry is preferred, ideally within banks, financial market infrastructures, regulatory bodies or supervisory authorities. A basic understanding of the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model and first line of defense (1LoD) risk and control responsibilities is expected.
• Initial exposure to or keen interest in at least one of the activities listed under your responsibilities, such as ICS quality, operational risk and controls, audit or supervisory remediation, external assurance, SII and CAP management, integrated control reporting, incidents, claims or resilience-related governance. Prior internship or traineeship experience in a related area is a plus.
• Ability to perform structured analysis, produce clear and accurate deliverables, follow up on tasks reliably and seek guidance proactively. Willingness to learn, ask questions and accept constructive feedback.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarise information clearly and contribute to the preparation of materials for management review.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail, curiosity, pragmatism and a willingness to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. A structured approach to problem-solving is valued.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel, familiarity with SharePoint and collaborative document management, ability to prepare clear presentations, and openness to learning and using AI-based tools and automation in daily work.
• Fluency in spoken and written English is required; German and French are an advantage.

title: Kapitän (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Chemgas Barging S.à r.l., Luxembourg
Inland shipping


Transporting gas on inland waterways in an efficient, reliable and safe manner. That is what we do and what we are good at. Chemgas is the market leader in the transport of pressurized liquefied gases on inland waterways. Our colleagues are committed to this 24/7, all year round. You too can contribute to this! We are looking for a captain for our inland shipping fleet.


What will you do?

As a captain, you provide motivating leadership and this enables you to ensure that our crew and the ship function optimally. You know how to guide your colleagues in the right way, ensure the pleasant working atmosphere on board and promote growth. In the position of captain, you are responsible for the safe, optimal and proper execution of the transport. You carry out your work within the framework of our ship policy and, where necessary, you contribute to improvements. In addition, safety is of paramount importance to you. You help ensure that all (safety) protocols and guidelines on board are complied with.


What ambition do you contribute to?

Chemgas is not standing still, and neither is our inland shipping branch. Our modern and well-maintained fleet is always evolving. We invest a lot of time and energy in new construction and conversion projects. In recent years, our fleet has been expanded with a number of new ships. New construction projects are also planned for the coming years and we are once again rejuvenating our inland shipping fleet. As a result, we are looking for additional talent to strengthen our team.

Partly because of our innovative ships, we strive for the highest achievable. Efficient gas transport for our clients is central and our employees are paramount. With your expertise, you can make an important contribution to this objective.


Are you looking after the vacancy?

You have an eye for safety, the environment and health and you also like to work in a team.


We also ask the following:

You are in possession of a Rhine patent up to at least Mannheim and you can also sail this route independently;
You are willing to obtain your patent up to Iffezheim;
ADN base and willingness to obtain ADN gas;
Radar patent;
VHF certificate;
EU Qualification Certificate.

What do we offer?

Is sailing on the wide rivers and canals in your blood? Are you also looking for a versatile job in inland shipping? Then Chemgas offers you many opportunities for a challenging career. Our inland vessels operate from Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp to Basel. We invest a lot in our employees and our ships. Our fleet is always evolving and equipped according to the latest techniques and innovations. Thanks in part to our motivated crew, there is a positive and enthusiastic atmosphere on board our ships. Expertise, dedication and discipline are paramount. On our inland shipping fleet, we only sail with Dutch-speaking colleagues. Chemgas is a committed company where a lot is possible and your work is appreciated. We focus on internal growth and therefore invest a lot of time in good training and advancement opportunities.

Our barge fleet operates from Luxembourg. Our sailing leave schedule consists of one week on board and one week at home, but two weeks on and two weeks off is also possible. On board you walk in a system of 8 hours on/8 hours. On an annual basis, you have the choice to work 24/28, 25/27 or 26/26 weeks. Would you like to know more about our terms of employment or do you have questions about this? Do not hesitate to contact us and we will be happy to help you!

title: Finance Manager, EU AMXL (m/f)
description:
Finance Manager, EU AMXL
Job ID: 10507726 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU AMXL Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to own the financial strategy and controllership within the AMXL Fulfillment space. Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) manages the end-to-end fulfillment of heavy and bulky products — a strategic, high-growth segment for Amazon in Europe, operating across multiple countries with diverse operational and legal frameworks.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a finance leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and shape decisions that affect the long-term economics of the EU AMXL network. The successful candidate will own financial planning and controllership for their area end-to-end, partner directly with Director-level operations and network leaders, and drive strategic analyses that inform multi-year network topology, rate, and investment decisions. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with data, build mechanisms that scale, and bring clarity to ambiguous, complex problems.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Finance & Decision Support:

- Own the financial plan (OP1/OP2/QxG) and long-range outlook for your area, independently building models and scenarios that inform network strategy.
- Lead high-impact analyses (e.g., network topology, rate setting, cost-to-serve, business cases) and present recommendations directly to senior leadership.
- Challenge operational and business partner assumptions with data, providing disruptive ideas where the numbers warrant it.

Business Partnering & Influence:

- Act as the trusted finance partner to Director-level operations, planning, and network leaders, influencing strategic decisions without direct authority.
- Navigate across organizations (e.g., Network, Transportation, Supply Chain, Accounting, Procurement) to align stakeholders and drive outcomes.
- Translate complex financial trade-offs into clear narratives for both Finance and non-Finance senior audiences.

Controllership & Operational Excellence:

- Own financial reporting integrity for your area (month-end close, variance analysis, cost controls), routinely delivering error-free outputs.
- Proactively identify control gaps and risks driven by business, regulatory, or operational change, and design solutions.
- Invent and institutionalize mechanisms (dashboards, automated reporting, planning tools) that scale across the team and network.

Leadership & Force Multiplication:

- Mentor and coach junior analysts, raising the bar on analytical rigor across the team.
- Contribute to the broader Finance community through best-practice sharing, hiring, and development initiatives.
- Identify and drive process improvements that remove bottlenecks and improve decision-making speed across the org.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in AMXL Finance. You might start the morning partnering with an operations leader to pressure-test a network change, spend mid-morning deep in a cost-to-serve model that will shape next year's topology, then present your findings to senior leadership in the afternoon. You'll move fluidly between the detail (validating a cost driver, reconciling a variance) and the big picture (where should we invest, what's the long-term economic story). You'll be the financial voice in the room — challenging assumptions, surfacing risks early, and helping the business make smarter, faster decisions. Expect autonomy, real ownership, and the space to build mechanisms that outlast any single planning cycle.

About the team

We are the EU AMXL Inbound & Middle Mile Finance team — a small, high-trust group of finance professionals supporting one of Amazon's fastest-growing and most operationally complex segments. We own the financials for how heavy and bulky products move through the European network, from inbound and cross-dock through to middle mile transportation. We work closely with operations, planning, and network teams across multiple countries, and we pride ourselves on combining analytical rigor with genuine business partnership. We care about developing our people, learning continuously, and making the work both impactful and enjoyable.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
- Experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
- Experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced or master's degree in finance, economics, or mathematics, such as a CA, CMA, CWA, or MBA
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions

Marketplace Consultant, German Speaker, Automotive Team
Job ID: 10504986 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon's Automotive category is a rapidly growing segment within our marketplace, catering to millions of customers searching for vehicle parts, accessories, and tools. As we expand our efforts in this sector, we're seeking a Marketplace Consultant to join our Strategic Account Services Team in Luxembourg, focusing on the Automotive vertical.

In this role, you'll provide strategic consultancy to Automotive Selling Partners, helping them navigate the complexities of e-commerce and maximize their potential on Amazon. Your expertise will span various aspects of the Amazon Marketplace, including international expansion, portfolio optimization, fulfillment strategy, product presentation, promotions, advertising strategy, and brand building within the Automotive sector.

As a Marketplace Consultant specializing in Automotive, you'll manage your own portfolio of Selling Partners, developing tailored strategies to drive their business growth and program satisfaction. You'll use your analytical skills to identify untapped potential in the Automotive category and support the recruitment and onboarding of new Automotive Selling Partners to our services.

With increasing complexity of today's ecommerce and rise of opportunities in the Automotive sector, the Strategic Account Services Team aims to leverage the full potential of each Amazon Selling Partner on Amazon. Our team provides leading-edge strategic consultancy using a data-driven, collaborative, and customer-focused approach to support our Selling Partners to achieve their goals. Our holistic service offering addresses advice on all facets of the Amazon Marketplace, with a specific focus on Automotive-related challenges and opportunities.

WHAT OUR MARKETPLACE CONSULTANTS SAY ABOUT THE ROLE:

· "Building a consulting program within Amazon from scratch, while advising Amazon's key Automotive Sellers on strategic growth opportunities"
· "Contribute to our Automotive Selling Partners' growth and satisfaction, while experiencing a unique way of working"
· "Full customer responsibility for a portfolio and project leadership to develop the program and your career in the Automotive sector."

Key job responsibilities

· Selling Partner Management: Manage a portfolio of 19 Sellers to develop individual strategies.
· Run Business Analyses: Produce profound business recommendations and actionable insights by interpretin customer data within the category.
· Consultancy: Use your knowledge to leverage solutions for sellers objectives. Consult on opportunities and potential business impact.
· Support Operational Troubleshooting: Guide your sellers on the execution of strategic plans, answer ad-hoc questions, and help overcome operational and subject-specific challenges.
· Build relationships: Gain the trust of each seller through close collaboration and delivering results.
· Recruit: Identify, qualify, and engage with prospective sellers based on a clear understanding of their needs.
· Business Reviews: Prepare and present performance deep dives to facilitate a monthly discussion around business progress, challenges, and strategic plans with your sellers.
· Become an Expert: Own a specific subject within our service organization with the goal to support peers, invent processes/tools to the benefit of our internal and external stakeholders, e.g. Branding, Fulfillment by Amazon, Hiring, Tools, Deals and a lot more, with a focus on Automotive-specific needs.
· Automotive Industry Knowledge: Demonstrate a strong understanding of the Automotive aftermarket, including trends, regulations, and customer needs specific to the European market.

About the team

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data, with the ability to transform data into actionable insights
- Experience in strategic planning
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
- Excellent English and German language skills
- Experience in top-tier level consulting, key account management, advertising sales, B2B, digital retail / ecommerce, Business Development, Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Supply Chain Management or similar

Preferred Qualifications

- Account Management and paid services experience
- Experience in the Automotive aftermarket or related fields

title: Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence (m/f)
description:
Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence
Job ID: 10503194 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.

Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.

Key job responsibilities

- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.
- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.
- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.
- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.
- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.
- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.
- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.
- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.

About the team

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.
- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.
- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.
- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.
- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.
- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.
- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.
- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.
- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.
- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.
- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.

title: Financial Analyst (m/f)
description:
Financial Analyst
Job ID: 10501109 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.
The Amazon University Talent Aquisition Team (AUTA) is looking for ambitious Graduates to join us at the heart of our core consumer business. The Financial Analyst will work closely with multiple Pan EU teams within our Category Excellence organization such as Inventory, Management, Planning, Pricing and Operations to streamline our reporting and controlling processes. We are looking for someone who can go beyond reporting and tell the story behind the numbers and propose corrective actions.

title: Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (m/f)
description:
Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1145

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

One of the key missions of the Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function is to conduct independent and risk-based investigations to protect the Bank's assets, reputation, and integrity, while ensuring compliance with Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) regulatory requirements.

As a Financial Crime Prevention Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in the detection, assessment, and investigation of potential financial crime risks. This position requires strong regulatory knowledge, excellent interpersonal skills, a genuine investigative mindset, and the ability to navigate complex situations involving AML/CFT, reputational, tax, and other financial crime-related risks.

Your next challenge:

• Review, assess, and investigate cases involving potentially suspicious activity and financial crime concerns.
• Conduct enhanced due diligence, background checks, adverse media reviews, and open-source intelligence research on prospects, clients, counterparties, and transactional parties.
• Analyze customer profiles, account activity, transaction flows, corporate structures, and supporting documentation to identify red flags and assess potential risks.
• Document, structure, and synthesize investigative findings, presenting well-supported assessment to the Compliance Incident Committee (CIC).
• Gather and compile all relevant information required for the preparation and submission of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
• Draft high-quality SARs/STRs based on comprehensive assessments of client activity, transactional behavior, and overall risk exposure.
• Act as a key liaison with the FIU and support responses to regulatory inquiries and requests.
• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Front Office, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to support investigations and manage financial crime risks.
• Keep abreast of evolving financial crime typologies, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Your skills:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Crime Compliance, AML/CFT Investigations, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience dealing with financial crime matters, suspicious activity investigations, and high-risk client relationships.
• Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and investigative methodologies.
• Knowledge of banking activities, legal structures, financial products, and client relationships is considered a strong asset.
• Previous experience in Front Office, Credit, Client Relationship Management, or other banking functions would be highly valued.
• Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
• Knowledge of any additional European language would be considered an asset.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Strong investigative mindset with a genuine interest in conducting research and uncovering complex financial crime patterns.
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to connect information from multiple sources and formulate reasoned conclusions.
• Strong synthesis and report-writing abilities.
• Curiosity, resilience, sound judgment, and the confidence to challenge when required.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of integrity, discretion, and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
description:
International Tax Senior Advisor
Locations Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

title: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (m/f)
employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
description:
Career Opportunities: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (124470)
Requisition ID 124470 - Posted 31/07/2026 - Luxembourg - Luxembourg - Activity area (1) - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years' experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.

• Background in mathematical finance.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.
• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.

• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:

    A fast-learner
    A flexible team player
    Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
    An entertainer at heart
    Excellent customer service skills

    Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.

Required Skills

    Prestationsbonus
    Gratis gym

    Många sociala aktiviteter, såsom PlayStation, pingis, årlig båttur och temadagar för olika högtider som jul, St. Patrick’s Day och mycket mer
    Sjukförsäkring

Om företaget

Företaget du kommer att arbeta för har som mål att hjälpa operatörer att lyckas och samtidigt erbjuda slutanvändare en förstklassig användarupplevelse genom ett professionellt och lokaliserat Live Casino.

Visionen är att behålla och stärka sin position som världens ledande leverantör av Live Casino i takt med att spelmarknaderna fortsätter att utvecklas globalt.

Studion på Malta sänder på 18 olika språk och våra team består av över 40 olika nationaliteter, vilket skapar en dynamisk och internationell arbetsmiljö.

Om jobbet

Som Online Game Presenter ansvarar du för att spel som Poker, Blackjack och Roulette genomförs korrekt och professionellt. Samtidigt är det ditt ansvar att spelarna vid ditt bord får en professionell och engagerande internationell spelupplevelse.

Du kommer att tillbringa större delen av arbetsdagen framför kameran, där du presenterar spelen och interagerar med spelarna. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina presentations- och kommunikationsfärdigheter samt din förmåga att hantera flera saker samtidigt.

Som Game Presenter tar du presentation och underhållning till en helt ny nivå.

Du kommer att ha livliga, positiva och interaktiva samtal med spelarna vid bordet och bidra till att skapa en engagerande spelupplevelse genom din energi, personlighet och förmåga att underhålla.

Vi kräver ingen specifik tidigare yrkeserfarenhet, men vi ser gärna att du har arbetat deltid eller heltid i minst ett till två år, gärna inom service, kundservice eller liknande.

De första tre veckorna av din anställning kommer att tillbringas på vår Academy, där du får utbildning i hur du presenterar Blackjack- och Roulette-spel samt hur du agerar professionellt framför kameran.

Dina kvalifikationer

💭 Du talar och skriver svenska (eller finska) på modersmålsnivå och har goda kunskaper i engelska (stark B2-nivå).

🎓 1–2 års erfarenhet inom service, kundservice eller liknande är meriterande.

💻 Du är serviceinriktad och har god kommunikationsförmåga samt förmåga att hantera kunder professionellt online.

💪🏻 Du är snabblärd, flexibel och en lagspelare.

🥇 Du är professionell, mogen och ansvarsfull, har lätt för att följa arbetsrutiner och regler och har en naturlig vilja att prestera och nå dina mål.

Als parttime helpdeskmedewerker ben jij het belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor de huurders van sociale huurwoning van de Alliantie in Hilversum. Dankzij jouw inzet ervaren bewoners een prettig en zorgeloos woonproces. Of iemand nu belt over beschikbare woningen, een storing in huis of vragen heeft over betalingen. Je bent enthousiast, communicatief vaardig en weet goed om te gaan met verschillende emoties. Je denkt graag mee in oplossingen en vindt het belangrijk dat huurders zich gehoord voelen. Klantvriendelijkheid zit bij jou in de kern en je helpt mensen met plezier verder.

title: Leefcoach (contactverzorgende) - Locatie Hoeve Zuid in Veldhoven
description:
Wij zijn Comfor
Wij zijn impactmakers in de ouderenzorg. Anders denken. Anders doen. Zo maken wij elke dag het verschil in de ouderenzorg. Alles wat we bij Comfor doen, draait om één doel: de beste beleving en het goede gevoel voor onze ouderen.
Bij Comfor gaat het om échte aandacht. Echte aandacht bij Comfor betekent dat we de tijd nemen voor een glimlach, een praatje, een kop koffie en gewoon samen genieten.
We luisteren, vragen door en spelen in op wat iemand nodig heeft. Zo maken we elke dag waardevol. Samen creëren we geluksmomentjes. En we maken het werk leuker én slimmer door technologie en innovatie op de juiste manier in te zetten. Zo versterken we elkaar, elke dag opnieuw.

Hoeve Zuid
Ouderen met een Wlz-indicatie kunnen hier eventueel samen met hun partner wonen én vooral leven! Want wij hebben oprechte aandacht en maken tijd. Bijvoorbeeld voor een ommetje of kopje thee. Samen met de oudere en hun naasten creëren we ultieme ondersteuning en zorg. En zo creëren we natuurlijk ook een ultieme werkomgeving die bijdraagt aan jouw persoonlijke gevoel van verbondenheid, comfor(t) en geluk!

Zo maak jij het verschil
Net als wij weet jij dat zorg écht anders kan: persoonlijker, jij kijkt samen met bewoners naar wat het beste past en zorgt zo voor een waardevolle dag! En juist in die kleine dingen zoals de glimlach, het praatje of gezellig een kop koffie, ontstaan de echte poedersuiker-momentjes, momenten waarin je echt het verschil kunt maken voor hun dag én jouw werk.

Wat jou typeert? Jij bent het zonnetje in huis. Jij denkt niet in hokjes, maar in kansen. Je onderzoekt, je probeert eens iets uit, leert en groeit.

Denk jij ook dat het anders kan?
Als Leefcoach ben jij het vaste, vertrouwde gezicht voor een aantal bewoners én hun naasten. Jij kijkt verder dan de situatie en ziet de mens. Je organiseert alles wat de bewoner nodig heeft en zorgt dat het goed verloopt. Samen maken jullie een leefplan dat écht past bij iemands leven, gewoontes en wensen. Jij zorgt dat collega’s dit plan goed uitvoeren, bewaakt de kwaliteit en evalueert steeds opnieuw: wat heeft deze bewoner nú nodig? Je voert gesprekken met bewoners en mantelzorgers, werkt samen met andere professionals én begeleidt collega’s en stagiaires. Jij bent coach, verbinder én zorgprofessional in één.

Ben je Verzorgende IG en heb je al een EVV- of GVP-certificaat? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen. Wel in het bezit van je Verzorgende IG diploma maar nog geen EVV / GVP certificaat? Geen probleem. Bij Comfor leiden we je binnen ons kennis & expertise centrum op tot Leefcoach.

Bij ons draait alles om het leven van de bewoner. Zorg is er vanzelfsprekend, maar het leven staat écht centraal!

Wil jij écht van betekenis zijn? En zie jij, net als wij, dat het anders kan?

Sluit je dan aan bij Comfor.

Samen maken we elke dag het verschil voor ouderen.

Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.

Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

Upforce history

SEP Peeters Oirlo
The employment agency SEP Peeters Oirlo was founded in 1997 when it started sending out Polish temporary workers, but the name SEP Peeters was already active in the poultry industry in the early 1980s. The need for additional labour was so great that in 1997 it was decided to move over as a temporary employment agency alongside services in the poultry industry. From 2000, the service provision within the poultry industry was stopped and SEP Peeters switched completely to the temping of labour.
SEP Peeters was based in Oirlo and from here around 600 temporary workers were put to work. title: Postdoctoral Researcher - Molecular Drivers
description:
Postdoctoral Researcher - Molecular Drivers of BRCA1-Related Precancer - - Amsterdam
Job details Application Job description
We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher to join a newly funded Gray Foundation Team Science project tackling one of the most important unsolved problems in cancer prevention: what drives the very first steps of breast cancer initiation in BRCA1 mutation carriers. Working at the interface of human tissue biology, single-cell genomics, spatial imaging, and functional mouse modeling, you will help map the genetic and phenotypic landscape of BRCA1-deficient precancerous cells in prophylactic mastectomy specimens and translate those discoveries into functionally validated driver candidates - a unique opportunity to do science that directly connects to clinical cancer interception.
The Jonkers laboratory at the Netherlands Cancer Institute has built a world-leading platform for functional breast cancer modeling, combining germline genetics, intraductal somatic engineering, and quantitative in vivo imaging. We are now applying that platform to study the biology of BRCA1-associated precancer and are looking for an exceptional postdoctoral researcher to lead this work.
You will work with a novel mouse model that combines germline heterozygous Brca1 deficiency with a dual-color fluorescent reporter that marks cells undergoing Cre-mediated loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in real time. Our preliminary data show that Brca1 LOH cells are actively cleared from the ductal epithelium in vivo, and this clearance is rescued by Trp53 loss. This provides a quantitative and mechanistic benchmark for ranking candidate perturbations.
Candidate driver genes will be introduced somatically at low frequency in mice - closely resembling the occurrence of early mutations in BRCA1 mutation carriers - through intraductal delivery of high-titer lentiviruses encoding Cre with cDNAs for overexpression or CRISPR guides for loss-of-function...

title: Vi søker en butikkselger i 80% stilling med visuelt ansvar til vår butikk på Alnabru
description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

 

Brenner du for Retail? Elsker du salg og får energi av å yte topp service? Lar du deg inspirere av interiør, tekstil, møbler og trender? Trives du også med at du får dine daglige skritt i løpet av en arbeidsdag, og at en dag aldri er lik den neste? Da er vi i Kid kanskje en perfekt match for deg!

Vår butikk på Alna Senter på Alnabru søker en ny butikkmedarbeider i 80 % stilling. Stillingen betegnes som VA, dvs ansvarlig for at butikken til enhver tid leverer etter kjedens føringer på varer og kommunikasjon. Stillingen inngår i butikkens lederteam.

Vi søker etter en selger som uten å tenke seg om møter våre kunder, kollegaer og leder med et stort smil og et «hei». Du utstråler energi og blir giret av å levere gode resultater. Du er i tillegg dedikert og fleksibel, og finnes ikke redd for å ta på deg verken nye oppgaver og ansvar.

 

 Vi har spurt våre kolleger om hva som er det beste med å jobbe i Kid, og da svarer de:

«Kid har gode verdier og evner å se enkeltindividene»

«Det er enkelt å lære seg å bli flink i jobben sin og det gir en god mestringsfølelse»

«Det legges til rette for gode fremtidsutsikter og Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver»

«Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!»

 

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • Sørge for at kundene våre får tidenes beste kundeopplevelse
  • Sørge for at butikken er visuelt inspirerende og til en hver tid etter kjedens føringer mtp både varer og kommunikasjon.
  • Være en i teamet som ser hva som må gjøres av stort og smått og som tar initiativ, også før noen spør deg
  • Leverer oppgaver av høy kvalitet og i tide
  • Jobbe målrettet for å oppnå salgsmål

 

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Drømmer om en jobb i salg- og kundeservice
  • Har erfaring fra visual merchandising
  • Har øye for det visuelle, er kreativ og jobber strukturert
  • Er glad i å lære bort og lykkes gjennom teamfølelse
  • Er energisk, utadvendt og glad i folk
  • På en naturlig måte, skaper en god relasjon og kommunikasjon med kundene våre. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du snakker godt norsk.
  • Kan jobbe dag, kveld og helg og er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid
  • Trives med å jobbe ut ifra konsept, og det er en styrke om du i tillegg har estetisk sans
  • Trigges av resultater, og har ambisjoner på egne og andres vegne
  • Er «fremme i skoa», tar initiativ og liker at ingen dag er lik en annen

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En utfordrende stilling i en kjede med flotte kvalitetsprodukter
  • Spennende karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter for de som vil og kan
  • En «levende» bransje med store variasjoner, hvor den enkeltes innsats teller
  • Deltidsstillinger som fint kan kombineres med skole og utdanning
  • Et nettverk av butikker over hele landet som også gir muligheter for å jobbe i andre avdelinger
  • Et bonussystem for alle faste medarbeidere som er ansatt over 20%

 

Med en veldreven organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen, ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder er butikkleder. Du vil bli del av et sammensveiset team med dyktige kolleger, både i egen butikk, i regionen og som en del av et stort nordisk konsern.

NB! Vennligst ikke send søknaden din pr e-post til oss. Kun søknader som sendes via vår rekrutteringsportal vil bli vurdert. Gå inn på karrieresiden vår karriere.kid.no for å sende oss en søknad.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...
