title: Workday Integration Lead
description:
Your New Role

Are you an experienced Workday integration professional ready to take on a leading role in a large-scale transformation? We are looking for a Workday Integration Lead to join an ambitious implementation program within a large and highly regulated organization.

In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and delivering integrations between Workday and a wide range of enterprise systems, including HR, payroll, identity management, finance, and third-party applications.

You will provide technical leadership throughout the transformation, helping to assess, migrate, redesign, and modernize more than 100 existing integrations impacted by the Workday implementation. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical expertise with architecture, stakeholder collaboration, and technical leadership.

Your responsibilities

    

Lead the design and redesign of Workday integrations.

    

Define integration architecture, standards, and best practices.

    

Build scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.

    

Act as a technical advisor and support key architecture decisions.

    

Collaborate with implementation partners, architects, business analysts, and application teams.

    

Identify technical risks and dependencies and ensure compliance with security and operational requirements.

    

Mentor internal developers and strengthen Workday integration capabilities within the team.

Company Presentation

Our client is a leading player in the banking and finance sector with over 100 years of history – yet fully focused on the future. Driven by entrepreneurial thinking and innovative ideas, they describe themselves as an IT company with a banking license. If you want to combine technology, innovation, and finance in a company that challenges traditional norms, this is the place for you.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Working model: Hybrid Start date: October 2026 End date: 2027-10-01, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

    

At least 7 years of experience in enterprise integration development.

    

At least 4 years of hands-on experience with Workday integrations.

    

Proven experience from Workday implementation or transformation projects.

    

Strong knowledge of Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, APIs, Web Services, XML, JSON, REST, and SOAP.

    

Experience integrating Workday with HR, payroll, finance, identity management, and third-party systems.

    

A strong understanding of cloud integration architecture and security.

    

Knowledge of HR processes such as Core HCM, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll.

    

Meritorious: Experience from financial services or another highly regulated industry is highly valued.

What we Offer

    

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

title: Aerodynamics engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our R&D team as an Aerodynamics Engineer and help shape the future of energy technology by designing highly efficient and reliable turbomachinery components. You will drive innovation in compressor aerodynamics, contributing throughout the entire development process—from initial concept and CFD simulations to validation and long-term product support. Every day, you will deliver solutions that enhance performance and sustainability, ensuring our products meet the highest standards of efficiency and robustness. Step into a role where your work directly impacts the energy transition and the reliability of tomorrow’s power generation.

How You will Make an Impact

    Contribute to the aerodynamic design of high-performance turbomachinery compressors using advanced numerical tools, including both in-house and commercial software.
    Perform CFD calculations and analyses on compressors and related components, such as intake houses, flow cavities, and bearing houses, utilizing tools like ANSYS CFX, StarCCM+ and TRACE.
    Implement and develop optimization tools and new methods to enhance R&D efficiency in line with Siemens Energy’s vision.
    Build a local and global network by collaborating with colleagues across Europe, North America, and Asia, and work closely with teams in Aero mechanics, Mechanical Design, Mechanical Integrity, Test, and Manufacturing.

What You Bring

    You hold a Master’s or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field.
    You have knowledge and interest in fluid dynamics, both theoretical and experimental, mathematics, and programming as well as an experimental background.
    You are highly motivated, passionate, and approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
    You thrive in a collaborative team environment and actively contribute to team effectiveness.
    Experience in turbomachinery and Swedish language skills are a plus; advanced English proficiency is required.

About the Team

You will join a diverse R&D Compressor group of, more than, 20 skilled engineers specializing in aeromechanics, aerodynamics, mechanical integrity, structural dynamics, and rotor dynamics. Our team is dedicated to advancing compressor technology in a supportive, collaborative environment. Based in Finspång, we are recognized for our expertise and commitment to continuous development, always challenging ourselves and each other to stay at the forefront of innovation. As part of the Gas Services division, we deliver high-performance, low-emission power generation through advanced gas turbine technology. By driving decarbonization and modernization, we energize society and accelerate the global energy transition.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 302432 not later than 2026-09-11.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

Volvo provides movement in a safe way. To create safe products and functions that keep people in the car safe, we use data - lots of data. We have an opportunity for you that are looking for how your data gives purpose and wants to take on the challenge with large data volumes. Ready to talk?

     What you'll do  

As a Data Engineer in SVA (Safe Vehicle Automation) Data Management & Platform you will be involved in building & maintaining data pipelines and organizing data. The data you produce is used by other parts of our organization to generate insights, build AI models, and do verification of software/systems. You work continuously to automate all parts of your data and control flows. You are involved both in hands-on development in the team and engaged in end-to-end improvement and evolution across teams. You are using and influencing data storage systems and actively engage in making the systems efficient and safeguarding the need for your business is considered.

     What you'll bring  

We believe you are an experienced professional with 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with a general understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing, and big data technologies. You can design, develop, and operate data pipelines, and see the value of observability and traceability build in from start.You have strong communication skills and are engaged in internal and cross team relations that you nurse and evolve. You take your own initiative and can handle tasks even when they are not fully defined.From your background you bring strong competence in programming languages such as Python, experience from working in Unix/Linux environments and shell scripting, and Software development workflow (GitLab, Gerrit, Airflow and Jenkins). It is merit if you have experience from Containerization, Kubernetes and PBS. Experience from system development with Cloud systems like AWS/GCP/Azure is a merit. To be able to interact with and contribute to data storage, we believe you have basic experience in database systems, preferably in relational databases, SQL, NoSQL, and data pipeline orchestration (we use Airflow). You have a good knowledge of data models so you can design and debug them. You are a problem solver that can move between high level view and design details, possess analytical and problem-solving skills that you use for troubleshooting data and pipelines

title: Produktionsplanerare - Rock Drilling Tools
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Inom Rock Drilling Tools Division står vi inför spännande utmaningar kopplade till komplexiteten i försörjningskedjan. Vill du vara med och driva stabilitet och effektivitet i våra produktionsflöden? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera eget ansvar med nära samarbete – och där det finns stort utrymme att ta initiativ, utmana befintliga arbetssätt och skapa förbättringar över tid? Då kan du vara den vi söker till rollen som produktionsplanerare i Fagersta.

Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.

Bli en del av vårt team Hos Epiroc i Fagersta bidrar du till hållbara lösningar för gruv- och anläggningsindustrin världen över. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där erfarenhet, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Vi tror på öppen kommunikation, personligt ansvar och ett inkluderande arbetsklimat där olika perspektiv gör oss starkare.

Vår verksamhet präglas av avancerad produktion och högt tempo. Det innebär att ditt arbete får direkt påverkan på vår förmåga att leverera till kunder världen över. Du har ett självständigt ansvar, men är inte ensam eftersom framgång bygger på nära samarbete med kollegor inom produktion, logistik, inköp och andra stödfunktioner.

Ditt uppdrag Som produktionsplanerare har du en central roll i att skapa förutsättningar för en stabil och effektiv produktion. Du arbetar i gränssnittet mellan planering, materialförsörjning och produktion, där du löpande balanserar verksamhetens behov mot tillgängliga resurser.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:


    Säkerställa att material avropas och finns tillgängligt vid rätt tidpunkt
    Frisläppa och följa upp produktionsordrar
    Hantera kommunikation med leverantörer
    Följa upp lagernivåer och bidra till en balanserad lagerhållning
    Hantera avvikelser och eskalera frågor när situationen kräver det
    Medverka i utveckling och förbättring av planeringsprocesser

Rollen präglas av nära samarbete med flera olika funktioner och ställer krav på att du kan skapa överblick, fatta välgrundade beslut och anpassa planeringen när förutsättningarna förändras.

Din profilVi tror att du har erfarenhet av produktions- eller materialplanering, eller från en liknande roll inom tillverkande industri där du har arbetat med flöden, förändringar och leveransprecision. Du har ett analytiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och en god förståelse för hur olika delar av ett produktionsflöde hänger ihop. Du trivs i en miljö där förutsättningarna kan förändras snabbt och har förmågan att anpassa dig, prioritera om och hitta vägar framåt när nya utmaningar uppstår. Har du dessutom lätt för att sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och bidra med struktur, kommer du sannolikt att trivas hos oss.

Goda kunskaper i Excel och Office 365 är en förutsättning för att hantera våra dagliga analyser och planering. Erfarenhet av affärssystemet M3 är en stor fördel, då det är ett av våra huvudsakliga verktyg i planeringsprocessen. Vi ser även att du behärskar svenska flytande och känner dig trygg med att kommunicera på engelska, både i tal och skrift. Vi arbetar i en internationell miljö där båda språken används dagligen.

PlaceringDenna position är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige.

Livet på EpirocNär du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:


    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar bonus.

Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt via vår karriärsida. Sista ansökningsdag är den 20 september 2026. Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, välkommen att kontakta Lisa Ström, Rekryteringsspecialist, lisa.strom@epiroc.com.

title: Junior Bioinformatician with experience in eDNA
description:
We are seeking a motivated **Junior Bioinformatician** to work with computational analysis of environmental DNA (eDNA), metagenomic sequencing data, and machine-learning approaches for biological and forensic applications.

The position involves analysing complex sequencing datasets to identify biological patterns and develop computational methods for classification and prediction. A particular focus will be the analysis of microbial and environmental DNA profiles and their application to geographic inference and forensic intelligence.

## Main responsibilities

The successful candidate will:

* Process and analyse environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing datasets.

* Analyse microbial and other biological community profiles generated from environmental samples.

* Perform quality control, filtering, normalization, and feature selection of high-dimensional biological datasets.

* Apply statistical and machine-learning approaches to classification and prediction problems.

* Develop and evaluate computational models for geographic prediction from biological data.

* Analyse spatial patterns in biological communities and assess relationships between biological similarity and geographic distance.

* Evaluate model performance using appropriate validation and testing procedures.

* Work with large reference datasets containing biological and geographic information.

* Produce figures, tables, and statistical summaries of analytical results.

* Document computational workflows and contribute to scientific reports, presentations, and manuscripts.

* Work collaboratively with researchers in bioinformatics, molecular biology, environmental genomics, and forensic science.

## Qualifications

Applicants should have:

* A Master's degree, or be close to completing a Master's degree, in **Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology**, or a closely related discipline.

* Experience analysing DNA sequencing or other high-dimensional biological data.

* Experience with **Python and/or R** for data analysis.

* Basic knowledge of machine learning and statistical modelling.

* Experience working with biological community, microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data.

* Ability to work with large datasets and develop reproducible computational analyses.

* Good written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.

## Meritorious qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following is considered an advantage:

* Environmental DNA (eDNA) or metagenomics.

* Microbiome or microbial community analysis.

* Machine-learning methods for classification, prediction, or geolocation.

* Spatial analysis or geographic modelling.

* Feature selection and dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional sequencing data.

* Analysis of environmental or forensic biological samples.

* Linux and command-line bioinformatics.

* Development or evaluation of computational bioinformatics pipelines.

## About the position

This is a junior position intended for a recent Master's graduate or an applicant at an equivalent early-career stage. The position provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of **bioinformatics, environmental genomics, machine learning, and forensic science**, with an emphasis on translating biological sequencing data into practical predictive tools.

We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, independence, and an interest in developing computational approaches to challenging biological problems.

SSYK 2131 or 2511

    God språklig förmåga i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt

title: Assistant Professor - in Information Systems and Innovation Management
description:
The House of Innovation (HoI) at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) currently invites applications for one tenure-track position (Assistant Professor level).

Your profile and qualifications

Candidates are expected to have relevant background in Information Systems, Innovation Management or related fields. A research focus on Artificial Intelligence, Digital Health or Digital Resilience will be considered a plus. A PhD in a related field is required by the time of assuming the position.

Candidates are expected to have strong qualities in both research and teaching. In research, the candidate should exhibit the ability to publish in top-tier, peer-reviewed, international journals, as evidenced by a promising research and publication pipeline, a presence in the international research community, and publications in leading journals (if available). In teaching, experience with integrating GenAI into innovative teaching is a plus, as well as having designed and delivered university courses in management of digital technologies and/or innovation, and having coached student projects. Candidates will be expected to interact and collaborate with faculty from other disciplines and to exercise intellectual leadership in their discipline.

The position

The tenure track period is six years. The intended starting date for the successful candidate is September 1, 2027 (open to negotiation). Salaries are set on an individual basis. Tenure track faculty members are evaluated for tenure on a non-competing basis (i.e., based on individual performance).  

For these positions, course load is reduced from the regular 4 courses to 2 courses for the duration of the tenure track period.  

In teaching and research, there are ample opportunities to engage in collaboration with startups in the surrounding innovation ecosystem, as well as with a wide network of SSE partner organizations, including ABB, Accenture, Ericsson, H&M, McKinsey & Co, Scania, SEB and many others.

About the House of Innovation (HoI)

The House of Innovation provides an excellent, inter-disciplinary environment for research, education, outreach and venturing, with scholars working in Technology and Innovation Management, Entrepreneurship, Information Systems, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and adjacent fields. HoI collaborates with a broad, influential network of academics, corporations, government agencies, and civil society actors, with the aim to contribute to the advancement of society. HoI hosts an expanding group of international scholars with currently 8 professors, 5 associate professors, 13 tenure-track assistant professors, 17 PhD students and more than 35 research fellows and postdocs. Our researchers have access to important national research networks, such as WASP-HS, and are highly successful in publishing and grant acquisition, for example, with a recent major research grant on AI in healthcare.

HoI faculty members regularly publish in top journals, and serve on editorial boards, in editorial positions, and in academic leadership positions. They frequently receive substantial grants from leading Swedish and European funding institutions to conduct state-of-the-art research, and serve on national and international policy committees, thus contributing to the shaping of society and of innovation ecosystems. 

HoI encompasses the academic Department of Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Technology, the Jacob and Marcus Wallenberg Center for Innovative and Sustainable Business Development, the Scania Center for Innovation and Operational Excellence, The Center for Family Enterprise, The Center for Transformative Innovation, Center for Data Analytics, the research platform on innovation and sustainability within the House of Sustainable Society, and the Swedish Center for Digital Innovation (SCDI Sthlm). We also run the SSE Business Lab start-up incubator and coordinate SSE’s involvement in the Stockholm School of Entrepreneurship (SSES), a consortium with the six major universities in Stockholm providing innovation and entrepreneurship education across the wider Stockholm area and beyond.

How to apply:

To apply, please submit:

    A cover letter articulating your fit with the position description and the research diversity of HoI, and your research interests
    Teaching and outreach portfolio
    A curriculum vitae
    A separate document listing both published articles (if any) and articles submitted and under review with journals.
    Copies of representative research, including your job market paper.
    Names and contact information for three persons willing to provide references.

About the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE)

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

Our client is a leading company in the automotive industry, specializing in American car brands such as Dodge and RAM. They provide import, distribution, spare parts, and service solutions across Europe.

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Administrator to support the Head of Customer Experience. To succeed in this role, you are structured, detail-oriented, communicative, and able to manage multiple tasks while taking initiative and ownership.

German proficiency is a strong advantage, as much of the customer communication is in German, but it is not a requirement.

This is a six-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with the possibility of extension. The role is based on-site at our client’s office in Kista.

Work tasks

    Contact customers and suppliers, including international contacts.  
    Handle administrative tasks and support the Head of Customer Experience.  
    Follow up on cases and help resolve customer and supplier issues.

We are looking for

    Good knowledge of administration and order handling processes.
    Great communication skills in English, both oral and written.
    Good knowledge of ERP systems and order management systems.
    Good administrative skills with a strong focus on detail.
    Experience in Microsoft Office, for example Excel and Powerpoint.
    Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

It is meritorious if you have

    Great communication skills in Swedish and/or German, both spoken and written.
    Experience with safety recalls from a manufacturer’s perspective, regardless of industry, is considered a strong advantage, as this will be a key part of the role.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Supportive
    Stress tolerant
    Goal oriented
    Orderly

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Local Study Associate Director, Feasibility Lead
description:
Join us in shaping the future of cell therapy

Do you bring experience in clinical study feasibility, patient recruitment, and study delivery? Are you motivated by the opportunity to help shape innovative studies from the earliest planning stages and work with people across functions to make a real difference for patients?

We are now recruiting a Local Study Associate Director, Feasibility Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a chance to play an important role in our cell therapy portfolio, using your operational insight, strategic thinking, and collaborative approach to help set studies up for success.

About AstraZeneca
At AstraZeneca, we are driven by science and inspired by the difference we can make for patients. Across our business, we bring together deep scientific expertise, innovation, and collaboration to discover, develop, and deliver medicines that address some of the world's most serious diseases.

Within Oncology, we are advancing a bold pipeline, including cell therapy, with the ambition to transform outcomes for people living with cancer. It is a place where you can contribute to meaningful work, grow your career, and be part of a team that values curiosity, ownership, and partnership.

About the role
As Local Study Associate Director, Feasibility Lead, you will be at the heart of country-level feasibility for AstraZeneca's internally delivered cell therapy studies. You will help shape key decisions on study design, site selection, recruitment forecasting, and retention planning, ensuring that local insight translates into strong, realistic study plans.

You will also play an important role in local study delivery, leading cross-functional collaboration to ensure studies are progressed in line with timelines, quality expectations, and compliance requirements.

You will work closely with colleagues across Feasibility, Global Project Teams, Medical Affairs, Site Management & Monitoring, Site Partnerships, Patient Operations, and Study Management, as well as with investigators and site personnel externally. Your ability to build relationships, influence decisions, and bring people together around shared goals will be central to success in this role.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategy and delivery, and who wants to contribute to innovative clinical development in a highly collaborative environment.

What you will do

    Lead Local Study Teams to deliver study commitments to agreed timelines, quality, and compliance standards
    Support country start-up and study oversight, including site identification, qualification, and essential document readiness
    Maintain compliance and inspection readiness in line with AstraZeneca standards, ICH-GCP, and local regulations
    Contribute to continuous improvement in feasibility, recruitment, and retention practices
    Lead country feasibility activities for assigned cell therapy studies
    Provide local insight to support study design, site selection, country allocation, and recruitment planning
    Develop recruitment and retention strategies based on feasibility findings and delivery insights
    Partner with local and global stakeholders to align on priorities, risks, and opportunities

Essential Requirements

    Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, business management, or project management, or equivalent project management certification
    Significant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including drug development processes
    Minimum 1 year of experience in clinical study feasibility
    Experience developing and delivering study delivery strategies and tactical or operational plans
    Experience in patient and investigator recruitment and retention
    Proven project and budget management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work
    Strong stakeholder management, communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills in complex environments
    Good knowledge of ICH-GCP, basic knowledge of GMP/GDP, and good understanding of local regulations and clinical study management
    Good medical knowledge in relevant AstraZeneca therapeutic areas
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritisation, and digital skills

Desirable requirements

    Experience in cell therapy
    Experience working with CROs, AROs, or external partners
    Experience in new product development within the pharmaceutical industry
    Experience developing study delivery strategies aligned to local regulatory objectives
    Experience managing complex or cross-border projects
    Ability to work effectively with remote collaborators, adapt positively to change, and influence stakeholders
    A process innovation mindset, including the ability to identify opportunities for AI or digital tools to improve efficiency, quality, or innovation



Why join us?

This role offers the opportunity to make a visible contribution in an innovative and fast-moving area of clinical development. You will help shape how studies are planned and delivered locally, work with experienced colleagues across a broad network, and contribute to work that has the potential to change patients' lives.



What's next?
Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and cover letter, no later than September 16th, 2026 .

To help us review your application smoothly, please combine your CV and cover letter into one document before uploading.

title: Boat builders to Windy Scandinavia in Västervik
description:
Eterni is looking for skilled and experienced boatbuilders who want to help meet the growing demand for well-known exclusive boats in Västervik

Eternis client Windy Boats in Västervik is looking for a boat builder. As a hired boat builder at Windy, you will work in Västervik and be part of a team of skilled and competent boat builders. Windy, a well-known brand in the boat industry, develops and manufactures exclusive boats, and as the boats get bigger and more technically advanced, you'll continually have the chance to grow and learn new things. The boat models they build range from 26 to 77 feet.

JOB TASKS

The work mainly involves assembling, installing, connecting, and commissioning all equipment on a boat. It also includes various other tasks, such as installing plumbing, engines, steering systems, and hydraulic equipment. We would like you to have experience working in boat building. You need to be able to handle power tools and work on installations in boats with high quality. Formal requirements:

• Several years of experience in the industry and working professionally with details and millimeter precision.

• Very good knowledge of, and experience with, installations on a boat

• You should understand and be able to communicate technical issues as well as interpret drawings

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES AND QUALIFICATIONS

Eterni is looking for someone who is thorough, flexible, and responsible. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. You are practical and able to work in a team, but also independently. You are curious and eager to learn new things. You take responsibility, take initiative, and see problem-solving as a challenge. To succeed in this role, we also believe you have the following skills and qualities:

• Vocational education as a boat builder

• Strong interest in boats and general knowledge about boats

• Are unpretentious and gladly offer a helping hand to neighboring departments within the company

• Enjoy a role where, with your professional skills and extensive experience, you can help train less experienced colleagues

• Ability to understand and communicate technical issues as well as comprehend the content of drawings

• Fluent in Swedish or English

ABOUT THE POSITION

The job as a boat builder is a full-time consultancy assignment. You will be employed by Eterni and work as a consultant for Windy. After six months, there is a very high possibility of being employed directly by Windy, provided there is interest in relocating to Västervik. For foreign boat builders, there is housing available in Västervik. Similarly, housing may be available for those living elsewhere in Sweden with several years of experience as a boat builder.

The opportunity to work 2-shift is required.

Applications are accepted in Swedish or English.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We work with continuous selection, so don’t wait to submit your application. Apply by registering on eterni.se and attach your CV and personal letter.

title: Global Demand Planning Analyst to Husqvarna Forest & Garden Division
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

About the Organization:

Our Collaborative Business Planning (CBP) function plays a critical role in aligning strategic objectives with operational execution across the organization. Through strong cross-functional collaboration with product management, sales, operations, and finance, the CBP process (also known as Integrated Business Planning) ensures that decisions are data-driven, forward-looking, and fully integrated.

Within the CBP function, the Demand Planning Excellence team develops and governs global demand planning processes, supports execution, and strengthens capabilities across markets and functions.

About the Role:

As a Global Demand Planning Analyst for finished products, you’ll work in a dynamic, cross-functional, and international environment. As part of the Demand Planning Excellence team, you'll play an important role supporting sales organizations in delivering accurate, data-driven demand plans. While sales organizations own the demand plans, you will support them with high-quality analysis, governance, lifecycle management, system expertise, and process development.

You’ll join a small, experienced team on an exciting journey to enhance the global demand planning process, with an increasing focus on digitalization, advanced analytics, and AI as key enablers of Demand Planning Excellence.

This is a fixed-term role covering parental leave.

Key responsibilities:

    Proactively analyze demand plans and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to improve forecast quality and support business decisions.
    Ensure reliable demand plans are published to supply planning teams.
    Coordinate product lifecycle changes, including new product introductions and phase-outs, to ensure accurate planning throughout the product lifecycle.
    Serve as a key expert for the Logility planning system and our demand planning processes, providing user support, training, and driving system and process enhancements.
    Collaborate closely with sales, product management, supply planning, and other stakeholders to strengthen demand planning capabilities.
    Support and drive continuous improvements in demand planning KPIs, reports, processes, and ways of working.

About you:

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and thorough, with strong communication and collaboration skills. You have a strong sense of ownership and a genuine service mindset. You take initiative and are committed to delivering high-quality results on time.

Your skills and background:

    A university degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or related field.
    Experience within demand planning, forecasting, S&OP/IBP, supply chain, or another planning-related discipline.
    Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with large datasets and translating data into actionable business insights.
    Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools.
    Experience with Logility or another advanced planning system is considered an advantage.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across functions and cultures.
    Experience or curiosity in using AI, GenAI, or digital tools to improve analysis, planning processes, and ways of working is considered an advantage.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Location:

This position is located in Huskvarna. Please note that this is a parental leave cover starting in October or November.

How we work:  

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your Application:

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we find the right person. For more information about the position, contact Hiring Manager Malin Sand on malin.sand@husqvarnagroup.com . For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin on nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture:

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.    

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

title: Automation & Control System Engineer
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

About the role:

To help us realise our goal of being the most powerful neutron source in the world, we are now looking for an Automation & Control System Engineer to join the Automation Section, located within our Integrated Control Systems (ICS) Division.

The scope of the Automation Section is to design, develop, deliver and maintain control systems based on industrial automation technology such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) and to integrate them with the EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System) software infrastructure. The Automation Section develops and maintains also the control system operator interfaces (OPIs), as well as the archive and alarm configurations of the PLC-based control systems.

As an Automation and Control System Engineer at ESS your responsibilities will be the following:

    Lead the development, integration, verification, and validation of control systems, ensuring compliance with relevant procedures and standards.
    Define schedule and costs while exploring innovative approaches and conceptualizing solutions.
    Document design/development.
    Review other engineering designs.
    Stay current with emerging start-of-the-art technologies.
    Collaborate with system owners to facilitate successful deployment of integrated control systems.
    Provide technical support to team members on PLC technologies and EPICS integration.
    Develop and maintain key control projects, including the new PLC/EPICS Integrator tool.

This position is a full-time, permanent role with a 6-month probationary period. It is based at the brand-new https://youtu.be/d5h4bIEfM5Q?si=W28A9wLAkYK3HOXJ. We would like this position to start as soon as practically possible.

About you:

We are seeking a proactive, self-motivated, responsible, structured Automation or Control Systems Engineer who is eager to grow in a fast-paced, impact-driven environment. You should enjoy working both independently and together with others within a team and are comfortable communicating with both in-house technical teams and external stakeholders.

The following qualifications and experience are mandatory for this position:

    A Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a very closely related field.
    Proven experience in control system design and implementation within a research facility or industrial setting.
    Strong expertise in:

    PLC programming, according to standard IEC 61131-3.
    Motion control systems.

    Knowledge of Python, C/C++ and Linux OS.
    Knowledge of Gitlab.
    Knowledge of the EPICS Framework.
    Experience with Beckhoff PLC.
    Proven ability in independent problem-solving and solution development.
    Excellent technical writing, reporting, and documentation skills.
    An excellent track record of working with configuration management tools, source code management tools and version control systems.
    Fluency in both oral and written English.

Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Particle accelerator systems technology.
    Prior experience of working with EPICS software tools, including SNL and Sequencer module.
    Knowledge of pytest and PySide6 python modules.
    Siemens PLC and Siemens tools such as Openness and Test Suite Advanced.
    Prior experience of working in a complex, international project or plant.
    Experience of using collaborative electronic project management tools, such as Jira.
    Good communication skills in both written and spoken Swedish.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. Submit your application as soon as you can and quote the job reference number ESD-82392 in your application.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for an Information Management Manager for our Project Services team. In this role you will report to our Head of Project Services and sit within our Project Delivery function. The team supports the project by ensuring that information, documentation, and project data are structured, accessible, and managed according to our requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

As Information Management Manager, you will take ownership of the project document management function and lead our team of Area Document Controllers. You will ensure that technical documentation meets project standards and requirements while developing our ways of working, systems, and interfaces with EPCM partners, OEMs, suppliers, and internal project teams.

Employment: Permanent with 6 month probationary period

Placement: Boden

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Lead and develop the team of Area Document Controllers, creating consistent ways of working across the project
    Develop and continuously improve document management procedures, standards, and instructions
    Take a leading role in our Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), Omega 365, providing guidance and support across the project
    Work with EPCM partners, OEMs, and suppliers to ensure documentation requirements and standards are understood and followed
    Manage and improve the use of Master Document Registers (MDR) and Document Distribution Matrices (DDM) to track project deliverables
    Drive improvements in the quality and structure of project information to support construction, commissioning, regulatory requirements, and handover to operations
    Support integration between the EDMS and other information management platforms, including the Asset Information Management platform
    Develop reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility of documentation status, progress, and outstanding deliverables

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    8+ years of experience within document control, information management, or a similar role
    Strong understanding of document and data requirements within construction projects
    Previous experience working with Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), with experience in Omega 365 and Autodesk Construction Cloud particularly relevant
    Experience leading and developing document control teams
    Good understanding of Master Document Registers (MDR), document distribution, and tracking of technical deliverables
    Experience working with contractors, EPCM partners, suppliers, and multidisciplinary project teams
    Good knowledge of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools
    Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in English

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Business Controller
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a broad finance role where your analyses help guide purchasing decisions, investment planning and continuous improvement in a complex industrial environment. The work spans everything from monthly reporting and forecasting to business cases, cost scenarios and financial support for cross-functional initiatives.

You will work close to buyers, project managers and other specialists, combining hands-on financial work with advisory support. This is an interesting opportunity if you enjoy turning numbers into clear recommendations and want to influence both day-to-day decisions and longer-term improvements.

    Fluent English.
    Experience from finance systems such as SAP and Essbase.
    Strong skills in Excel, Power BI and Office 365.
    You are comfortable working in a structured and proactive way and can drive topics independently.

Nice to have

    Experience from purchasing.
    Experience from the automotive industry.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Senior Linux Platform Engineer
description:
About Kambi

Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners.

Our vision is to create the world's leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners.

Do you want to join a growing team responsible for the layer between hardware and applications?

Kambi are in the middle of a DevOps transformation and are building a sustainable organisation for the future. For our Engineering Operations department, we are searching an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer with automation skills. We are looking for people who are passionate to learning modern technologies, thrives when collaborating with others, have an agile mindset and are solution oriented.

Who are we?

Engineering Operations supports the infrastructure of the organisation and the success of our partners. We ensure a stable environment twenty-four seven,year-round and we like open source in all flavours. We are dedicated to agile operations, believe dev-ops and automation are great ways of achieving that, whilst using agile methodologies to support our efforts along the road.

We thrive in collaborative, ever-changing environment where we are using the collective resources of the team to meet objectives and find the best solution together.

The role

In this role, you'll build and maintain on-prem infrastructure with a wide variety of technologies around the globe. You'll do this by delivering reliable, scalable, and universally available systems.

Technologies we are working with today include Ubuntu, Debian, infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, NTP), globally hosted servers,

virtualization (KVM), storage (Ceph), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), automation (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - reusable workflows) and private cloud environments, alongside our on-prem infrastructure.

Who are you?

We're looking for a solution-oriented team player with a solid background in Linux. It is also beneficial if you have experience with infrastructure automation, basic understanding of networking (such as dynamic routing, data centre switching, site-to-site VPNs) and a "security first" approach.

An agile mindset is crucial for us, and additionally experience working with Ubuntu, Debian and Puppet profiles would be a great fit within this team.

You will like us if you:

    Think code & automation is the right way to evolve infrastructure.
    Driven and motivated to find the best solution to the problem at hand.
    Find technically complex systems thrilling.
    Detail orientated.
    Enjoy home labbing or tinkering with infrastructure in your own time.
    Enjoy working in a self-organizing, self-managing team.
    Thinks business value delivered is what defines great operations.
    Like to work within a large global environment.
    

Sound like your next challenge?

If you're excited by Linux, automation, and building reliable infrastructure for a global platform, we'd love to meet you.

Apply now and become part of a team that's building the future of our platform.

Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace

If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.

Creating an inclusive environment

We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today.

description:

title: À la carte kock / À la carte chef
description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

Restaurangen  

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet för större arrangemang.  

Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för en storslagen fjällvärld, midnattssol och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter.

Kock  

Som medarbetare i vårt kök på Camp Ripan är du en stor del i det som gör att gästerna får en minnesvärd matupplevelse utöver det vanliga. Här representeras vår trekulturella region i form av noggrant utvalda råvaror i spännande smakkombinationer.  

Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, här arbetar vi med den senaste tekniken för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön.

Vi söker nu dig som trivs med att jobba i ett drivet arbetslag, där alla deltar och påverkar den kreativa processen, från idé till färdig produkt. Du har ett levande intresse för yrket, minst 6 års erfarenhet (3 år utbildning, 3 år av arbetslivserfarenhet i à la carterestaurang), goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper inom den lokala matkulturen och dess råvaror eftersom det är grunden i vår matfilosofi.  

Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov. Särskild visstidsanställning med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person.



At Camp Ripan you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by nature and culture that is special to our region. we value our employees highly and offer a workplace where you can grow and develope. You will become a part of a close-knit team where cooperation, service and respect for each other are fundamental.

The Restaurant

At the heart of Camp Ripan, you'll find our fantastic restaurant where we offer breakfast, lunch, and dinner as well as the opportunity for larger events.

Inspiration is drawn from the city's three cultures - the Swedish, the Sami, and the Tornedalian - and this permeates the entire operation. Now we're looking for someone who, in addition to a fun and challenging job, is ready for the magnificent mountain world, the midnight sun, and fantastic recreational activities.

Chef

As a member of our kitchen team at Camp Ripan, you play a significant role in providing guests with a memorable dining experience beyond the ordinary. Our tri-cultural region is represented here through carefully selected ingredients in exciting flavor combinations.

Camp Ripan's kitchen is one of Sweden's most environmentally friendly kitchens, where we work with the latest technology to minimize our impact on the environment.

We are now seeking someone who enjoys working in a driven team where everyone participates and influences the creative process, from idea to finished product. You have a keen interest in the profession, at least 6 years of experience (3 years of education, 3 years of work experience in an à la carte restaurant), and good knowledge of Swedish and/or English. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of the local food culture and its ingredients as it forms the basis of our food philosophy.

Staff accomodation is avaliable. Fixed-term employment with the possibility of permanent employment. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once we find the right candidate.

title: System Engineer to ALIARO
description:
Do you enjoy solving practical problems where hardware and software meet? ALIARO is looking for a Systems Engineer who wants to take responsibility for building, integrating, and improving test systems in a hands-on environment.

About the job

This is a direct recruitment, which means that the recruitment process takes place through Bravura and you are employed directly by the ALIARO

About the company

ALIARO was founded in 2014 with the ambition to deliver innovative and dependable testing solutions to clients across a wide range of industries worldwide. Since then, the company has grown into a leading provider of modular and reusable test solutions designed to adapt to changing technical and business needs.

The team consists of experienced engineers with deep expertise in testing and measurement. Continuous skill development is a natural part of the work, and ALIARO maintains close partnerships with leading hardware and software providers such as National Instruments (NI). Through active involvement in industry organizations like ASAM, the company stays ahead of evolving standards and technologies.

ALIARO is a smaller organization with short decision paths, where collaboration is close-knit and everyone has a clear impact on both projects and customers.

Tasks and responsibilities

As a Systems Engineer at ALIARO you work closely with both hardware and software, focusing on integrating, configuring, and developing test systems. The role is practical and varied, suited for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work in detail and taking ownership from setup to verification. You will troubleshoot across HW/SW boundaries, develop automation tools, and contribute to structured technical documentation.

Key responsibilities include:

• Integrating and configuring test and measurement systems

• Developing scripts and tools in Python for automation and workflows

• Working with NI platforms such as LabVIEW, VeriStand, PXI, and cRIO

• Troubleshooting and resolving issues across hardware and software

• Verifying systems using electronics and PCB knowledge

• Writing clear technical documentation and following established processes

Education, experience and personal characteristics

• Previous experience as a Systems Engineer, Test Engineer, or Electronics Engineer

• Solid understanding of electronics and PCB fundamentals

• Hands-on experience with NI software, especially LabVIEW and VeriStand

• Good knowledge of Python for automation and integration

• Experience working across hardware and software in practical environments

• Very good communication skills in English

We are looking for someone that is self-driven and likes to take responsibility for their own work, from identifying a problem to delivering a solution. You prefer practical, hands-on tasks and are comfortable switching between different technical challenges. You communicate in a clear and straightforward way and enjoy working closely with others in a small team where priorities can change, and decisions are made quickly.

Location: Krokslätts Fabriker 30B, 431 37 Mölndal

title: Assistant Professor in Business Administration, Corporate Finance
description:
With approximately 3,700 full-time students, 470 employees, 160 international partner universities and four departments, the School of Business, Economics and Law offers exceptional breadth and is Triple Crown accredited through EQUIS, AACSB and AMBA. The Department of Business Administration is the School’s largest department and conducts extensive research and education at first-cycle, second-cycle and doctoral levels. The position is based in the Industrial and Financial Management & Logistics (IFEL) section, which conducts research and education in areas including corporate finance and collaborates closely with research environments such as the Centre for Finance (CFF), Northern Lead and Lighthouse.

Subject area

Business Administration, specialising in Corporate Finance.

Subject area description

Corporate Finance examines firms’ financial decision-making, with a focus on investment decisions, financing strategies, and mechanisms for ensuring a market-based return for both shareholders and lenders. Central to the field is the development of theoretically and empirically grounded frameworks that facilitate profitable investments and efficient financing while taking risk and the cost of capital into account.

Particular emphasis is placed on analyzing the factors that influence firms’ choices of capital structure and investment strategies, especially in environments characterized by asymmetric information and transaction costs. A clear grounding in financial theory is essential for understanding, explaining, and analyzing these decisions and their consequences. The field has a strong methodological orientation, employing quantitative tools such as discounted cash flow models, real and financial option models, as well as statistical and econometric methods, to analyze how external market conditions affect firms’ financial decisions.

Duties

The position comprises a maximum of 50% teaching and a minimum of 50% research. Research is expected to focus on Corporate Finance, align with the subject area description above, and be of a quality suitable for publication in high-quality international scientific journals. Research is also expected to be actively disseminated through research seminars and academic networks.

The Assistant Professor will teach at first-cycle and second-cycle (Master’s) levels and is also expected to contribute to doctoral education and contract education, as well as course development and administrative duties. Teaching will primarily concern courses in Corporate Finance, including Corporate Valuation, Advanced Corporate Finance, Financial Management, or similar courses, as well as supervision of Bachelor’s and Master’s theses in finance and within Accounting and Financial Management.

The position also requires active efforts to apply for external research funding during the employment period and to contribute to the development of the department’s educational and research environment.



Employment

Type of employment: Fixed-term employment for five years



Extent: Full-time (100%)



Location: Department of Business Administration, School of Business, Economics and Law, University of Gothenburg



Starting date: By agreement



An appointment as Assistant Professor is a fixed-term career-development position. The purpose is to provide the successful candidate with the opportunity to develop independence as a researcher and strengthen scientific and pedagogical qualifications in order to meet the requirements for eligibility for appointment as Senior Lecturer. The appointment may be extended, but for no more than a total of two years, if additional time is required to fulfil the purpose of the appointment due to sick leave, parental leave, or other special circumstances.



Applications

You apply for the position through the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their application is complete in accordance with the advertisement and submitted no later than the application deadline. Please submit your application in English, as it will be reviewed by external reviewers whose working language is English.

Application deadline: 30 October 2026

There's something for everyone.

title: Senior Design Manager - Mechanical
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager - Mechanical to lead the mechanical and plumbing design delivery for our EPC projects for data center projects. This role sits within the Design Engineering function and is responsible for directing and quality-controlling the work of external engineering consultants, ensuring mechanical and plumbing designs are delivered on time, to budget and in line with  technical, safety, and operational standards for mission-critical facilities.

The Mechanical Senior Design Manager acts as the technical authority and single point of accountability for mechanical and plumbing design across assigned projects, working closely with other design disciplines, project delivery teams and both internal and external stakeholders to ensure a fully coordinated, constructible and operationally sound design solution.

Leadership of External Design Consultants

• Direct, brief, and manage external mechanical and plumbing engineering consultants across all project design stages, from concept through to issued-for-construction (IFC) and as-built documentation.

• Set clear design deliverables, quality expectations, and programme milestones for consultants, and hold them accountable against the agreed scope, fee, and schedule.

• Review and critically challenge consultant deliverables — calculations, schematics, drawings, specifications, and equipment schedules — before issue, ensuring technical robustness and compliance.

• Identify design risks, gaps, or underperformance early and drive timely corrective action with consultant teams.

Mechanical & Plumbing Technical Oversight

• Provide senior technical oversight of HVAC and cooling system design for data center environments, including CRAH/CRAC units, chilled water systems, chillers, free/adiabatic cooling, air handling, and airflow management.

• Oversee plumbing, drainage, and fire protection system design (including pre-action and other special hazard suppression systems typical of data center white space and support areas).

• Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and client/industry requirements (e.g. ASHRAE, local building and mechanical codes, Uptime Institute Tier requirements, and client-specific design criteria).

• Support resiliency, redundancy, and availability targets (e.g. N, N+1, 2N configurations) appropriate to each project's target tier and client specification.

Multi-Discipline Coordination

• Act as the mechanical/plumbing lead within the wider multi-discipline design team, coordinating closely with electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, and fire/life-safety disciplines.

• Drive resolution of cross-discipline clashes and interface issues through structured coordination reviews, including BIM/model-based coordination where applicable.

• Ensure mechanical and plumbing design integrates cleanly with construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and site logistics.

Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as the primary mechanical/plumbing design point of contact for internal stakeholders (project directors, project managers, construction teams, procurement) and external stakeholders (clients, authorities having jurisdiction, third-party reviewers, and commissioning agents).

• Present design status, key decisions, and risks clearly to stakeholders at design reviews and project governance meetings.

• Support commercial and procurement processes by providing technical input on consultant scopes, equipment selection,and vendor/contractor queries.
